heading: Simple pricing that grows with your team
subheading: Start free. Pay one flat monthly price when you need the IT service desk. People who only submit requests or tickets never need a seat.
footnote: Prices in USD, excluding tax. Every new organisation gets a 14-day Standard trial with no card. Non-profits and education get 30% off.

plans.name: Free
plans.description: For small QA teams getting their testing in order.
features: 3 projects, 1,000 test cases
Suites, cases, test runs and result history
Bug tracking and feature requests with voting
Spreadsheet import and export
Public ticket portal (1 project)
Live chat widget with TestMate branding
AI with your own key, plus 50 trial credits

plans.name: Standard
plans.description: For growing teams running testing and an IT service desk together.
plans.seatNote: Includes 15 full seats. Extra seats $2 each.
features: Everything in Free, no project or case limits
IT request portal, service catalog, forms and approvals
Service queue for IT agents, request deadlines
Client companies (up to 10) with two-tier support
SLA tracking with your own targets and breach escalations
Live chat and WhatsApp widgets, unbranded
100 AI credits each month, shared by the team
1-year activity log and email support

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For organisations and service providers that need control and scale.
plans.seatNote: Includes 50 full seats. Extra seats $1.50 each.
features: Everything in Standard, unlimited client companies
Custom roles and permissions
Multi-step approvals with approver groups
Identity checks before sensitive requests
Full service reports and provisioning API
500 AI credits each month, model choice per feature
Unlimited activity log retention
Priority support and onboarding
